name: Thai Chicken and Broccoli Curry
method: Cook the rice to the packet instructions, about 12 minutes, then drain and keep warm.
Heat the oil in a deep frying pan or wok and stir-fry the sliced onion for 5 minutes until golden, then lift out. Fry the chopped chicken thighs for 5 minutes until coloured all over.
Return the onion with the broccoli and sliced carrot and stir-fry for 2 minutes. Stir in the curry paste for 1 minute.
Pour in the coconut milk and 150ml water and simmer for 6 to 8 minutes until the chicken is cooked through and the vegetables are tender.
Spoon the curry over the rice and serve.
source: idea: Sainsbury's recipes (Thai green chicken curry, red paste swap)
